title: Prism Medical Products breach: Oregon filing says 1,326,066 individuals affected
date_note: HIPAA Journal (23 Nov) reports the company's breach notice dated 30 October and says the activity was first identified on 19 October; the California AG listing gives 18 October as the breach date. The pages read give no earlier public reporting day.
place: North Carolina, United States (city not stated)
geo_basis: headquarters state as stated by HIPAA Journal
summary: Prism Medical Products, a North Carolina home medical supply provider, says in its breach notice that it identified suspicious activity on parts of its network on 19 October. HIPAA Journal says the Oregon Attorney General was informed that the breach affected 1,326,066 individuals. The data includes names, contact details and, for some people, medical, insurance, financial and Social Security information. HIPAA Journal, not the company, says it appears to be Wallstreet ransomware.
plain: A medical supply company says attackers got into its network. HIPAA Journal says 1,326,066 people's data may be affected, including health and Social Security details for some.
exec: Health-data breach at a medical supplier affecting 1,326,066 individuals, per an Oregon Attorney General filing.
action: Prism Medical Products is mailing notification letters and offering 24 months of credit monitoring and dark web monitoring, per HIPAA Journal.
impact: Names, contact details and, for some or all people, medical, insurance, financial and government identifier data.

evidence.quote: the Oregon Attorney General was informed that the data breach affected 1,326,066 individuals
24 months of credit monitoring and dark web monitoring services

validation.note: California AG listing (read) and HIPAA Journal (read) citing the company's own notice and the Oregon AG filing. Iowa and Washington register entries exist but were not opened.
